item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently lifts the sanctions and declares that covered payments are no longer prohibited; the legal consequence occurs in this segment itself.","evidence":"payments from the United States and payments by U.S. persons in Panama to that government are not prohibited"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The segment directs executive officials to take later steps producing specified legal consequences: nonapplication of prohibitions and unblocking government assets.","evidence":"take steps to ensure that the prohibitions will not be applied to that government of Panama"}]}
